research.method: Public web search followed by official issuer and Skills England pages/documents only. Search results from nonprimary domains were discarded; none was opened or relied upon.
research.capture_mode: Web-tool parsed page/document evidence, not an archived byte-for-byte network capture. No remote body hash is claimed.
research.search_limitations: Two exact qualification numbers per query produced little relevant indexing for ABBE/CIH. Search budget was exhausted, then official sites were followed. No further query or read beyond requested bounds.

groups.original_proposed_literal_title: ABBE Level 3 Diploma in Professional Residential Property Letting and Management
literal_titles: ABBE Level 3 Diploma in Professional Residential Property Letting and Management

claim.source_locations: ABBE property catalog lines 55-57; qualification detail lines 45-49 and 66-79
claim.observed_fact: ABBE official detail associates exact title with reference 603/7089/0 and describes an occupational-competence qualification for residential lettings/property-management roles.
claim.inference: Academic/professional qualification intent is reinforced. A current title/detail page is not evidence that Professional adds new learning outcomes compared with 600/0988/3 or 500/9472/5.
claim.missing_resolution: Old and new specifications or official explicit replacement/content mapping were not obtained in the bounded reads.

groups.original_proposed_literal_title: ABBE Level 3 Diploma in Professional Sale of Residential Property
literal_titles: ABBE Level 3 Diploma in Professional Sale of Residential Property

claim.observed_fact: The official property catalog lists the complete Professional Sale of Residential Property diploma title.
claim.inference: This is corroboration of the title only; the catalog does not establish curriculum distinction or wording continuity from 600/1002/2 or 500/9471/3.
claim.missing_resolution: A qualification-number-bound old/new specification comparison or official replacement statement remains missing. The number binding here remains the pinned Ofqual projection, not this catalog page.

groups.original_proposed_literal_title: SQA Level 4 End Point Assessment for Conveyancing Technician
literal_titles: SQA Level 4 End Point Assessment for Conveyancing Technician

source_occurrences.published_status: No longer available to new learners

claim.source_locations: SQA specification pages 1-4, publication November 2018/version01; Skills England version log and options marker
claim.observed_fact: The SQA specification expressly binds 603/3689/4 to Conveyancing Technician EPA, with a scenario test and showcase/professional discussion. Skills England ST1312 pages identify an apprenticeship with options, log version1 approved from 2024-01-03 and version2 assessment-plan revision from 2026-06-08.
claim.inference: There are dated assessment details for the old numbered qualification and a later versioned options-based standard. This does not prove that qualification 610/5147/0 is equivalent to, replaces, or is substantively different from 603/3689/4.
claim.missing_resolution: The retrieved Skills England core occupational-standard/EPA sections display Content loading rather than route detail; no explicit old-standard-to-ST1312 conveyancing-route mapping or numbered new assessment specification was obtained. SQA component detail points to a secure system, which was not accessed.

groups.original_proposed_literal_title: CIH Level 4 Certificate For the Housing Profession (QCF)
literal_titles: CIH Level 4 Certificate For the Housing Profession (QCF)

claim.source_locations: CIH current catalog Level4/5 section lines283-310
claim.observed_fact: The official catalog describes a Level4 Certificate in Housing and its general management focus. The retrieved page does not supply a historical 600/3806/8-to-600/2138/X learning-outcome/title comparison.
claim.inference: A current course catalog cannot resolve whether historical Housing Profession and Housing Practice QCF titles had distinct scope.
claim.missing_resolution: Historical exact-number-bound specifications, unit/credit matrices or an official title-history/replacement statement remain missing. This is a bounded retrieved-page limitation, not a claim that such evidence does not exist.
